messages:
Sam: Hey team — procurement at HelioBank asked for a compact compliance package for the POC. They want a single-page snapshot we can attach to the contract review next week: SOC 2 attestation summary, ISO scope doc, network diagram for Private/Dedicated, pen-test attestation (signed or template), and a short note on log/audit retention. Also need clarity on whether Dedicated changes pricing/SLA for the POC. Can security/legal/solutions spin up a one-page artifact? Need by Tue EOD. cc @Jia for diagrams

Jia: I can assemble SOC2 summary, ISO scope excerpt, and a simplified network diagram (vpc + subnet + ingress points) — will redact internal IPs. Where should I drop the bundle? s3 or drive?

Eli: I’ll prepare a pen-test attestation template + our latest redacted report. Note: we don’t have a Helio-specific on-site test signed within 30 days — we can provide the standard vendor attestation and an internal control statement. If they insist on an out-of-cycle pen-test for their isolated env that’s a separate engagement (4–6w and estimate required). For the POC, template + signed letter (standard) should be fine. I can have draft by tomorrow AM.

Derek: Pricing/SLA note: short-term Dedicated trial is possible. Need expected qps and duration to price; SLA for Dedicated is 99.9% (enterprise tier) with included on-call. Extended retention or extended observability is extra. Procurement contact + rough usage will let me build a quote.

Sam: Good. Put the artifacts in a dedicated S3 folder and share a signed link. I’ll attach to the packet and hand to Helio procurement. Template name: helio-poc-assurance_snapshot.pdf

Jia: s3 works. I’ll upload to s3://redwood-compliance/helio/poc-2216789456/ and set a 30-day exp link. Uploading diagrams and SOC excerpt now.

Jia: Command I used:
```
aws s3 cp ./assurance_snapshot.pdf s3://redwood-compliance/helio/poc-2216789456/ --acl private
```

audit-bot: Document upload completed: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/compliance/helio/poc-2216789456/assurance_snapshot.pdf :white_check_mark:

Eli: Adding a short KMS/HSM statement and key rotation sample logs for Private deployment (they asked about key custody). Will include the rotation CSV and the key-policy excerpt.

Sam: Quick legal Q: do we need a PO before we provide a signed pen-test letter or just the template? Derek?

Derek: We don’t require a PO to provide the standard signed vendor attestation. For any customer-specific pen test (scanner access, on-site scope) we need a PO + SOW signed first.

Sam: Perfect. I’ll send the S3 link and the one-pager to Helio procurement now. Thanks everyone :pray:

Eli: FYI — if they push for SOC2 full report we can provide a redacted version and a redline of scope. Mention the redaction in the one-pager so procurement knows.

Sam: Noted. I’ll call out redacted sections. Targeting Tue EOD delivery to them.

Jia: Done — snapshot + diag + ISO excerpt uploaded. Link above.

Derek: I’ll draft the pricing note after Sam shares expected qps.

Sam: Sharing contact and estimated qps in DM. Thanks all :thumbsup:
